## Checklist

- [ ] Claims distinguish analogy, hypothesis, empirical evidence and formal result.
- [ ] No result is presented as execution authorization.
- [ ] Licenses, notices, provenance and sensitive-data boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Repository validators and `git diff --check` pass, or unexecuted checks are disclosed.
